text: The accounts of OKX UK Fintech Company Limited, filed at Companies House in March 2026, name OKC Holdings Corporation (Cayman Islands) as its ultimate parent company and Xu Mingxing as its ultimate controlling party, through his shareholding in OKC Holdings Corporation.

source.name: Companies House: OKX UK Fintech Company Limited (company 14670378), financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2025, note 11 'Control'
source.quote: The company's ultimate parent company is OKC Holdings Corporation, a company registered in the Cayman Islands. The ultimate controlling party is Xu Mingxing, by virtue of his shareholding in OKC Holdings Corporation.
